Dear Sir/Madam,

Jai Jinendra!

I wanted to personally follow up on my earlier emails and reiterate my sincere interest in building a close and long-term association with your esteemed organization.

HeatBolt has been a journey of six years of continuous research, innovation, perseverance, and execution. What started as an ambitious idea is now progressing towards a much larger opportunity, with encouraging engagement from government institutions, global FMCG leaders, and strategic industry stakeholders.

Our recent engagements with the PMO office and various ministries, along with discussions involving Nestlé, Barilla Group, Mondelēz, and Godrej, have further strengthened our belief in the potential of this technology platform.

Why I Am Reaching Out Again
At this important stage, we are looking beyond individual transactions or funding conversations. We want to identify a strategic organization with whom we can work closely, grow together, and build a globally scalable business.

We would welcome your guidance and participation in exploring:
1. Strategic investment and long-term growth capital.
2. Manufacturing partnerships and industrial-scale execution.
3. Global commercialization and distribution.
4. Technology licensing and strategic collaborations.
5. Joint development of new applications and market opportunities.

I strongly believe that the right strategic relationship can accelerate HeatBolt's journey and create significant value for all stakeholders.

A Personal Request: I would be sincerely grateful if you could spare 15–20 minutes for a personal interaction. I would love to walk you through our technology, current developments, commercial opportunities, and how we envision working closely with your organization.

We are ready to bring our team, demonstrate the technology, and discuss a practical roadmap for collaboration at your convenience.

I genuinely hope this can be the beginning of a meaningful and enduring partnership.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Warm regards,

Dr. Kumarpal Porwal
Founder & CEO | HeatBolt
